column3: “to live in accord with them” renders “to walk in them.”
“None of you” renders “a man, a man … not,” and “any blood relative of his” renders “any kin of his flesh.”
“have intercourse with” renders “give your lying for seed to.”
“to offer them to Molech” renders “to make them pass over to Molech.”
“have intercourse with” renders “give your lying to,” and “a perversion” renders “tevel,” a confusion.
“its punishment” renders “its iniquity,” and “spewed out” renders “vomited up” (also in verse 28).
NASB puts this verse in parentheses.
